scenes.headline: A multi-agent system as one looped network
scenes.sub: Each agent is a layer; latent states flow between them
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Ines! Let me show you how a whole team of agents can be scaled by looping them like one transformer.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Not a bigger model, not more agents. Scale the collaboration itself: loop the team in latent space and let it refine.
scenes.mark: loop the team in latent space
scenes.say: Not a bigger model, not more agents. Scale the collaboration itself. Loop the team in latent space and let it refine.

scenes.title: Two ways for agents to collaborate

left.title: Talk in text
items: Decode hidden states to words each hop
Re-encode them at the next agent
Slow, and the distribution is lost
left.say: The usual way, agents talk in text. Every hand-off decodes to words and then reads them back.

right.title: Pass latent states
items: Keep the hidden states, no decoding
One small link maps between agents
Faster, and trained as one system
right.say: This system keeps the hidden states instead, and trains the whole team as one.

scenes.title: Agents chained as a looped network

steps.say: Three agents become the layers of one network. Here a planner, a solver, and a critic.
Inside each agent an inner link turns its last hidden state into its next input. Latent thoughts, never written as words.
An outer link carries those latent states to the next agent, even when the models have different sizes.
The last agent loops back to the first. Round after round the team refines, and only the final round decodes to text.

scenes.title: The link is tiny

parts.note: a residual carries the embedding through
a two-layer net learns only the gap

scenes.say: The link itself is tiny. A residual carries the embedding through, and a two-layer network learns only the gap between the spaces.

scenes.title: Tokens fall as the loop deepens
scenes.note: fewer tokens than the text baseline
scenes.say: Deeper recursion cuts more tokens. About thirty-five percent at one round, up to seventy-six at three, because the middle steps are never re-decoded.

scenes.text: Scale a frozen team by training the links between them, not the models.
scenes.say: So the whole team trains as one. Agents as layers, latent links instead of text, and recursion as a new axis to scale.

recap: Loop for more, at lower cost
scenes.say: Agents become layers. Latent links, not text. Loop for more, at lower cost.
